author: misilva73
content:
Hey all! 

[This comment](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8037-state-creation-gas-cost-increase/25694/47) flags a possible `eth_call` regression with EIP-8037: geth’s reservoir split limits execution to ~16.7M gas, even when the call requests 50M. This could break expensive views like SVG renderers and quoters that work today.

I’d suggest keeping `eth_call` exempt from the transaction execution cap, subject to the node’s RPC limits, and clarifying that in the EIP. Actual transactions and gas estimation would still follow the cap and reservoir rules.

Does that sound right? Would appreciate an ack from client teams, or a heads-up if I’m missing a reason to keep the split for `eth_call`, before we make the change.
